Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9323 of 2022
Applicant :- Sherjan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sundeep Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sudhir Kumar Agarwal Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the records.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.444 of 2022, under Sections 323, 354, 376, 498A, 506 I.P.C and section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Nai Mandi, District Muzaffar Nagar with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Police Station Nai Mandi, District Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Facts in brief are that the applicant is father-in-law (Sasur) of the informant-victim who was wedded to Gulbahar (son of applicant).

As per version made in the F.I.R, the applicant is said to have committed rape with the informant on 26.8.2022 and when she complained to her husband and all the members of her family they assaulted her and caused injuries regarding which medical examination was done and thereafter the present F.I.R was lodged against the applicant, her husband and daughter.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that he is innocent and has committed no offence but for making pressure on him he has been named in the F.I.R with allegations that the applicant has committed rape with the victim.
It is also submitted that there was mutual dispute between husband and wife in which the applicant made interference and prevented his son that was the reason this present F.I.R has been lodged.

It is also submitted that the incident is said to have taken place on 7.00 O clock and medical examination was done at 9.55 P.M on the same date but no any such injury was found on her person to show that she was subjected to rape.
It is also submitted that the victim and her husband (son of applicant) are living together amicably after settling their mutual dispute.

The compromise entered into both the parties and affidavit is on record in which it has been mentioned that there was no any such incident with her relating to rape by the present applicant but on account of family dispute she lodged the present F.I.R.

Since, after investigation, charge sheet has been submitted by the police and now there is apprehension of arrest against the applicant in pursuance of process of Court, so request for anticipatory bail during pendency of trial.

Learned counsel for opposite party has admitted the fact that the informant and her husband are living together amicably and there is no dispute between both of them , therefore, he has no objection to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for opposite party as well as learned A.G.A for the State, there appears ground for anticipatory bail during pendency of trial.

(A) The applicant-Sherjan, involved in aforesaid case shall be released on anticipatory during pendency of trial on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.25,000/- with two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
(B) The applicant shall appear before the court concerned unless exempted.

(C) The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court.
(D) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
In default or misuse of any of the conditions, this order shall stand automatically vacated.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 G.S  Sherjan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36230798/
